title: Jasher

translation.name: Jasher — the 1840 translation
translation.translator: Attributed to Moses Samuel, unsigned in the edition
translation.edition: The Book of Jasher, referred to in Joshua and Second Samuel (New York: M. M. Noah & A. S. Gould, 1840)

rightsNote: Published 1840; the Internet Archive records the scan as not in copyright.
transmission: Joshua 10:13 and 2 Samuel 1:18 both name a book of Jasher and neither quotes it, so what that book contained is unknown. This is the 1840 English translation of the Hebrew Sefer haYashar printed at Venice in 1625, a retelling of Genesis and Exodus whose own preface claims the older book. The claim is recorded here, not endorsed: read it as what it is, a seventeenth-century Hebrew work in a nineteenth-century English dress.
editorialMarkers: None. The 1840 setting carries no editorial apparatus in its text.
